checks: A fresh campaign restores twelve undamaged portal defenses and clears destruction and firing records

Rift defenses are stationary hostile buildings without a moving infantry brain
Constructing all twelve hostile defenses does not add assault enemies, spawns or kills
Rift defense durability, range, shot strength, interval and reward match their advertised balance values
Distant base defenders are outside every rift defense's acquisition range
A rift defense acquires the actual nearby player and launches projectiles during the between-wave interval
The real traveling projectile collides with the player and applies one full advertised hit
Tracking and firing leave the defense building at its original position
A player beyond the 30-meter range is neither acquired nor damaged
A solid wall blocks acquisition and fire instead of allowing the defense to shoot through cover
A fired projectile requires travel time before damage reaches the target
Cover introduced after launch intercepts the projectile before it reaches the player
A sheltered player is excluded from defense acquisition and damage
The real defense acquisition and projectile path attack a nearby Marine health and collider
A sheltered Marine cannot be selected or struck by rift defense fire
The real defense acquisition and projectile path attack a nearby Squad health and collider
A sheltered Squad cannot be selected or struck by rift defense fire
The real defense acquisition and projectile path attack a nearby Tank health and collider
A sheltered Tank cannot be selected or struck by rift defense fire
A rift defense does not acquire a nearby member of its own faction
A real defense projectile intercepted by an invader does not inflict friendly damage
Invader damage cannot damage a rift defense of the same faction
A direct defense update while paused cannot fire or damage a target
Rift defenses stay inactive during the briefing
Rift defenses stop firing after victory
Rift defenses stop firing after defeat
A living defense cannot be registered as destroyed or claim a reward

Repeated damage and repeated world or director death notifications cannot award a second bounty
